arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import parse
import re

fmt = '''
            letters: {:w}
        '''

data = '''
            letters: abcdef
        '''

p = parse.Parser(fmt)
print("Expression:", repr(p._expression))
print("Data:", repr(data))
print()

# Try to match manually
m = p._match_re.match(data)
print("Match result:", m)
if m:
    print("Groups:", m.groups())
else:
    # Debug step by step
    for i in range(len(data)):
        sub = data[:i+1]
        m2 = p._match_re.match(sub)
        if not m2:
            print(f"Failed at position {i}: context={repr(data[max(0,i-10):i+20])}")
            break
    else:
        print("Never failed!")
EOF
